<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR modifies Prometheus rules and monitoring manifests: it switches several recording rules from apiserver_storage_objects to apiserver_resource_objects with explicit label normalization, updates HPA and kubelet alert expressions, renames scheduler binding histogram recording rules to use a new SLI metric, extends kubelet ServiceMonitor relabeling to drop storage metrics, adds four node-exporter recording rules for physical network interfaces, updates jsonnet dependency lock hashes, and introduces a new e2e test that queries several telemeter cluster metrics.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes
